2610.09891.title: A Scoping Review and Experimental Study on Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback for Human-Robot Collaboration
2610.09891.paper_summary: Human-Robot Collaboration (HRC) can facilitate mass customisation in Industry 4.0, with Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback (RLHF) representing a promising approach for developing safe AI-based robots. Practical challenges remain regarding safety during AI development, human feedback quality, and bidirectional human-robot adaptation. We conducted a scoping review of RLHF in HRC systems, mapping methods that address these challenges. Following PRISMA guidelines, we screened 199 records and included 20 peer-reviewed publications (2020-2025) spanning multiple HRC domains. To our knowledge, this is the first review focused on the bidirectional, closed-loop design of RLHF. Our review found multiple feedback modalities enabling data collection in various feedback formats. Collected data can be integrated at different stages of AI training, resulting in a multi-step development process. Pilot experiments are commonly used to evaluate HRC systems based on both human and robot metrics. To empirically test a key gap identified in the review, we conducted a between-subjects VR experiment comparing system- and user-initiated feedback on robot proxemic behaviour for safe navigation. Using Bayesian models, we analysed the relation between the collected feedback and safety metrics: psychological safety (post-experiment questionnaire) and physical safety (inverse time-to-collision). Results show that user-initiated feedback captures perceived safety better than system-initiated feedback, indicating that feedback timing directly affects feedback quality. Our review and experiment findings show that RLHF relies on appropriate feedback methods to ensure AI safety in HRC, and future RLHF research should prioritise realistic HRC experiments evaluating the effects of feedback collection methods on relevant human and robot metrics.
2610.09891.paper_summary_zh: 人機協作（HRC）可以促進工業4.0中的大規模定制，而來自人類反饋的強化學習（RLHF）則代表了一種有前景的方法，用於開發安全的基於AI的機器人。 在AI開發過程中，仍然存在關於安全性、人類反饋質量和雙向人機適應的實際挑戰。我們對HRC系統中的RLHF進行了範疇回顧，映射出解決這些挑戰的方法。根據PRISMA指導方針，我們篩選了199條記錄，並納入了20篇同行評審的出版物（2020-2025），涵蓋多個HRC領域。據我們所知，這是第一篇專注於RLHF的雙向閉環設計的回顧。我們的回顧發現多種反饋模式，使得可以以各種反饋格式收集數據。收集的數據可以在AI訓練的不同階段進行整合，從而形成一個多步驟的開發過程。試點實驗通常用於根據人類和機器人指標評估HRC系統。為了實證測試回顧中識別的關鍵差距，我們進行了一項受試者間的虛擬現實實驗，比較系統和用戶主動反饋對機器人近距離行為的影響，以確保安全導航。利用貝葉斯模型，我們分析了收集的反饋與安全指標之間的關係：心理安全（實驗後問卷）和物理安全（碰撞時間的倒數）。結果顯示，用戶主動反饋比系統主動反饋更能捕捉感知安全性，這表明反饋的時機直接影響反饋質量。我們的回顧和實驗結果顯示，RLHF依賴於適當的反饋方法以確保HRC中的AI安全，未來的RLHF研究應優先考慮現實的HRC實驗，以評估反饋收集方法對相關人類和機器人指標的影響。
